newsitem.title: GREECE: COUPON ON 10-YR GREEK BOND SET AT 8.80PCT- MIN.
newsitem.headline: COUPON ON 10-YR GREEK BOND SET AT 8.80PCT- MIN.

text.p: Greece's finance ministry said in a statement that it set the coupon on its first ever 10-year bond to be auctioned June 17 at 8.80 percent.
Greece will auction 100 billion drachmas of 10-year bonds on June 17.
It will also re-open bids for three-, five- and seven-year fixed coupon bonds on the same date. The state will auction 50 billion drachmas for each maturity.
The treasury said accepted bids would have to pay accrued interest, less of withholding tax on June 19 for the 88-day period elapsed since March 21.

The accepted bids will pay 2,216 drachmas for a three-year bond with a face value of 100,000 drachmas, 2,080 drachmas for a five-year bond and 2,013 drachmas for a seven-year bond of the same nominal value.

The finance ministry auctioned 150 billion drachmas of 9.8 percent, three-year bonds, 100 billion drachmas of 9.2 percent, five-year bonds and 50 billion of 8.9 percent, seven-year bonds on March 19. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
